name: Ag bot
tagline: Finds and ranks real growers and suppliers near you for any ingredient
description: Name an ingredient and it looks for growers and suppliers within reach of you, then ranks what it found by quality and distance. What comes back is a short list with names and locations, close enough to something a small food business can ring the same morning. It is aimed at kitchens and producers, not shoppers.
author: BlazeDrinkwine
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
